subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “History often hides in ordinary rooms.”?
options: A tool is not useless just because you do not use it every day."
Instead, because someone filled the silence with kindness, it became part of the show.
A kitchen can show technology, gender roles, trade, health, and the rhythm of a day.
Good technology should lead eyes back to the world, not trap them on a screen.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A tool is not useless just because you do not use it every day.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Instead, because someone filled the silence with kindness, it became part of the show.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「History often hides in ordinary rooms. A kitchen can show technology, gender roles, trade, health, and the rhythm of a day.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Good technology should lead eyes back to the world, not trap them on a screen.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「History often hides in ordinary rooms. A kitchen can show technology, gender roles, trade, health, and the rhythm of a day.」，答案為「A kitchen can show technology, gender roles, trade, health, and the rhythm of a day.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A kitchen can show technology, gender roles, trade, health, and the rhythm of a day.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
